android.desc:
Major new update

Collaborate and share files in PDF Spaces, turn your document summaries into podcast-style audio, and create standout content in Acrobat Reader with design and editor tools powered by Adobe Express. The world's most trusted PDF reader, editor, signer, converter and maker with more than 635 million installs. View, share, annotate, add comments, sign documents - all in one app. You can store your files online and use this reader to view anywhere. Get your 7-day free trial and try all the features of Acrobat Reader.

Paid features

Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant • Work across multiple files in one place with PDF Spaces. Collaborate, store, and use AI Assistant across files • Use voice or text prompts with AI Assistant chatbot • Ask questions and get cited answers about info in your document, including charts, graphs, and tables with Figures Q&A • Easily share the responses you get • Try voice support to ask queries and have answers read aloud. • Instantly generate summaries from your PDFs with Generative AI Summaries • Get content for emails, text, study notes, blogs, and more [Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant is a paid feature*, free for a limited time] Edit documents • With our PDF editor, edit text and images directly in your document (mobile only) • Fix typos or add paragraphs to your PDF with the built-in editor • Easily add, delete, or rotate any image straight in your PDF Reader and editor Recognize text • Acrobat Reader has Optical Character Recognition (OCR) that turns scanned PDFs into searchable, editable text to use in other formats Merge & organize PDFs with PDF converter • Split or combine multiple files into one PDF • Use the PDF editor to insert, delete, rotate, crop & reorder pages in your PDF file PDF converter to make & export • Easily convert to PDF from any file type including Microsoft, Google Docs, and images • A converter to export PDFs to Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or various image files • The ultimate file maker: convert web pages into PDFs Compress & highly secure PDFs • Compress PDF files for easy saving and sharing • Looking for a secure way to protect your information and signature? This PDF signer lets you Password Protect documents Have your PDF read aloud • Acrobat Reader lets you listen to your PDFs on the go • Choose free voices or upgrade for high-quality options • New: get PDFs read aloud through Android A
